entries.zh: 马衣；鞍褥，覆于马背或垫于鞍下的毯布
entries.en: horse blanket; saddlecloth (gualdrapa), cloth laid over or under a saddle
entries.notes: 西语词头疑为 Gualdrapa（马衣、鞍褥），据汉字“馬坐”与闽音两字定为鞍马铺垫之义。

entries.zh: 藏；保存，收藏
entries.en: to hide; to keep, store, preserve
entries.notes: 闽音首音节声调标记污损（T99），语义据西语 guardar/conservar 与汉字“藏”定为收藏保存义。

entries.zh: 贮存为家产；囤存财物
entries.en: to keep, store up as property or goods (hacienda)
entries.notes: 汉字“芬”与西语 gloss 义不合、疑有误写，缩写 gr. 未展开，暂据西语 gloss 权宜释义。

entries.zh: 隐藏；掩藏（互见 encubrir／esconder 条）
entries.en: to hide, conceal (cross-reference: see encubrir, as esconder)
entries.notes: 闽音栏为互见条目（参 encubrir、esconder），声调标记污损（T99），汉字“厓”读音存疑。

entries.zh: 怀；怀藏于身心，如孕妇之怀胎
entries.en: to carry within oneself, harbor in the bosom or heart, as one with child
entries.notes: 闽音首字两读存疑，据汉字“懷”与西语“如孕妇怀于身”定为怀藏义。

entries.zh: 蓄；蓄积，蓄藏许多东西
entries.en: to store up, accumulate many things

entries.zh: 积；积聚，积攒财物
entries.en: to accumulate, gather together, as wealth or goods

entries.zh: 存；保存，留存
entries.en: to keep, preserve, retain

entries.zh: 藏；收藏，隐藏
entries.en: to store away; to hide, conceal

entries.zh: 把守，看管（某物），如家宅之看守者
entries.en: to keep, watch over something, as the keeper (la guarda) of a house
entries.notes: 西语释义此处残缺，闽音栏第二字两读存疑，据“la guarda de casa”与汉字“把帶”推断。

entries.zh: 隐；隐匿，保守秘密
entries.en: to conceal, keep (a secret) hidden
entries.notes: 闽音首字两读存疑，据西语“守密”与汉字“隐”定为隐匿义。

entries.zh: 押；典押，抵押（留存作担保），扣押看管
entries.en: to pawn, pledge; to hold as security or in custody

entries.zh: 把；把持，执拿看守（如官府司法吏役之拿管）
entries.en: to hold, keep in hand or in custody, as officers of justice do

entries.zh: 看；看管，照看（物事）
entries.en: to watch over, look after a thing; to observe
entries.notes: 汉字“省”与闽音栏读音不合、疑原字为“看”，据西语 mirar／guardar 定为照看守视义。

entries.zh: 守；守卫，守望（如哨兵）
entries.en: to guard, keep watch as a sentry

entries.zh: 把定；把持守定，坚守不放手
entries.en: to hold fast, keep firm and steady; to take careful charge of
entries.notes: 西语释义残缺（cuidar fir… 之后缺损），据汉字“把定”与西语 cuidar 定为坚守把持义。

entries.zh: 守家；看守家宅
entries.en: to keep and guard the house

entries.zh: 庵主；庵堂寺庙之住持、主持人
entries.en: one who keeps the temple; prior or abbess, head keeper of a religious house

entries.zh: 庵公；看管庵庙之人（庙公）
entries.en: caretaker, warden of a temple; temple keeper

entries.zh: 安分；安守本分，安于本位
entries.en: to keep to one's own station; to be content with one's lot
